VETERAN PAY GUIDE

Privacy notice

Understand what stays in your browser and which third-party services load when you visit this website.

Source review: October 16, 2026 · How we review content

Calculator inputs

The calculator processes your rating and household selections in your browser. Our application code does not submit those form values to a server, save them in cookies or local storage, or place them in page URLs. You do not need to provide your name, claim number, or account credentials to use it.

Website analytics

This website loads Ahrefs Web Analytics to help understand visits and page usage. Ahrefs describes this product as cookie-free analytics. Page visits and technical usage information are processed by that service; calculator form values are not sent by our application code.

About Ahrefs Web Analytics ↗ · Ahrefs privacy policy ↗.

Hosting and fonts

Vercel hosts the website and receives network requests needed to serve it. Google Fonts provides the typefaces and receives requests when fonts load. Those providers handle request information under their own policies, which may include IP addresses and technical browser data.

Vercel privacy policy ↗ · Google Fonts privacy information ↗.

External links and public corrections

Official benefit links lead to websites operated by VA, SSA, and other organizations. Their privacy policies apply once you visit them. Corrections submitted through GitHub Issues are public and handled by GitHub. Do not submit personal benefit or financial information there.

For a privacy question about this website, use the public website issue tracker ↗ without including sensitive information.

Changes to this notice

This notice describes the current implementation and was updated October 16, 2026. It should be revised when the website’s data-handling practices change.
